svg.title: TPU communication lowering and routing
svg.desc: Two compilation paths converge at LLO and feed hardware DMA, routing, and the network. Routing algorithms populate on-chip routing tables using a dashed connection. JAX / PyTorch: jax.lax.all_gather, pmean, torch_xla Pallas / Custom Kernel: pl.pallas_call(), pltpu.async_copy StableHLO / JAXPR Graph XLA HLO Collectives: all-gather, all-reduce, all-to-all XLA Backend Emitter: lowering_emitter.cc / LoweringUtil Mosaic MLIR: tpu.enqueue_dma / tpu.wait_dma2 HLO Wrapper: tpu_custom_call (Bypasses HLO Collectives) Mosaic lower_to_llo: Directly calls LLO Region Builder LloRegionBuilder::EnqueueDmaGeneral() VLIW Bundle Packing & DMA Descriptor State DMA Descriptor: addrs, sync_flags, dma_type, target_chip_id / multicast_id Routing Algorithms: • Unicast Routing • Multicast Routing On-Chip Routing Tables: Egress & Link Next-Hop Physical BoardFly Interconnect: VC0 -> VC1 Switch -> Dest Memory
